ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: To eat rice is to take an ordinary meal; Chan records repeatedly use the action in direct answers and in formulas pairing eating with dressing, sleeping, or daily work.
EvidenceBody: The word remains ordinary eating. Zen bends it by putting the unexceptional act into public answers and tests, without making every meal a metaphor.
